name: feature.notifications.nodes
description: In-app notification node over ctx.features.notifications — the ONE notification owner (notifications/emitter.ts: durable row + SSE + Web Push + Teams + email). Replaces core.openwop.integration.notification-push in chains: that node requires a per-recipient deviceToken no chain author can know, so it POSTed to an undefined address and reported success. Audience is EXPLICIT (tenant | self | role:<name>) — never inferred from how the run started.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Notify: In-App
nodes.description: Emits one in-app notification (inbox row + SSE + the user's configured push/email channels) over ctx.features.notifications. Audience is explicit: `tenant` broadcasts, `self` addresses the run's acting user, `role:<name>` addresses a role (default-deny). Reports `emitted:false` with a reason rather than silently succeeding.
